title: The 3 Best Robot Lawn Mowers Under $800 in 2026
h1: The 3 Best Robot Lawn Mowers Under $800 in 2026
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for robot lawn mowers under $800 in 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at robot lawn mowers under $800 in 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Husqvarna Automower 115H
products.blurb: Key specs: 0.4-acre (17,000 sq ft) coverage, Boundary wire guidance, 4G connectivity with app control.
strengths: Strong resale and long-term reliability track record
4G connectivity works without relying on home WiFi range
limitations: 0.4-acre ceiling is the tightest coverage limit in this budget tier
No GPS-based multi-zone support at this price
Boundary wire install adds real time upfront

products.name: Worx Landroid M (WR147)
products.blurb: Key specs: 1/4-acre (10,890 sq ft) coverage, AIA narrow-passage navigation, 20V Power Share battery, shared with other Worx tools.
strengths: Frequently the lowest-priced model with narrow-passage navigation in this tier
Power Share battery compatibility adds value for existing Worx tool owners
App-based no-go zones are easy to configure for gardens or pet areas
Floating blade disc handles minor unevenness without extra cost
limitations: Smaller coverage ceiling than the Automower 115H
Some owners report a more involved initial setup and occasional resets
Still requires boundary wire for the main perimeter
features: 20V Power Share battery, shared with other Worx tools
Typically sold under $800 depending on retailer promotions

products.name: Segway Navimow i105N Wire-Free Robot Lawn Mower
limitations: Needs clear sky view for RTK
